source.publication: 2025 PIT-RES Resident Individual Income Tax Return Instructions and Form PIT-RES 2025; tax rate schedule from 30 Del. C. §1102(a)(14)
source.section: Instructions PDF p.6 Line 6 Pension Exclusion (under-60 rules, 60-or-over worksheet lines 1-4, eligible retirement income, NOTE, example); Instructions PDF p.7 Line 8a Social Security/Railroad Retirement Benefits; Instructions PDF p.8 Line 21 Additional Standard Deduction items 1-5; Form PIT-RES Lines 1-12, 20a-24, 26-27b, 32-33; Instructions PDF p.5 Line 1; PDF p.8 Line 20a standard deduction table, Line 24, Line 27a; PDF p.9 Line 27b; tax rate schedule 30 Del. C. §1102(a)(14) (record brackets cite)

worked: Federal (given, not tested): federal AGI = wages (you) 30,000.00 + ira distribution (you) 3,000.00 + private pension (you) 6,000.00 + taxable social security 10,000.00 + interest 1,500.00 + dividends 1,000.00 = 51,500.00. (Gross Social Security 24,000.00; the federal taxable part 10,000.00 is in AGI.) Federal taxable income = 51,500.00 - standard deduction 15,750.00 - 1 x 2,000.00 additional for age 65 or older = 33,750.00 (federal senior deduction ignored). Form PIT-RES (filing status 1 single, Column B): Line 1 federal AGI 51,500.00; Line 2 other states' obligations interest 0.00; Line 3 0.00; Line 4 total 51,500.00. Line 5 U.S. obligations interest 0.00. Line 6 pension exclusion, you (age 66): worksheet line 1 pension 6,000.00; line 2 eligible retirement income = IRA 3,000.00 + interest 1,500.00 + dividends 1,000.00 = 5,500.00; line 3 = 11,500.00; line 4 lesser of 11,500.00 and 12,500.00 = 11,500.00. Line 7 0.00; Line 8a taxable Social Security 10,000.00 = 10,000.00; Line 8b 0.00. Line 9 (Lines 5-8b) = 21,500.00. Line 10 = 51,500.00 - 21,500.00 = 30,000.00. Line 11 0.00 (Line 11 worksheet: earned income is 2,500 or more, so no). Line 12 Delaware AGI = 30,000.00. Line 20a standard deduction (filing status 1) 3,250.00; Line 21 additional standard deduction 1 box(es) for 65 or over x 2,500.00 = 2,500.00; Line 22 = 5,750.00. Line 23 taxable income = 30,000.00 - 5,750.00 = 24,250.00. Line 24 tax, §1102(a)(14) schedule as numbers: 2.2% x 3,000.00 = 66.00 + 3.9% x 5,000.00 = 195.00 + 4.8% x 10,000.00 = 480.00 + 5.2% x 4,250.00 = 221.00; total 962.00 (the Division's tax table, not in the sources, would give a row figure; expected keeps the formula). Line 25 0.00; Line 26 = 962.00. Line 27a personal credits 1 x 110.00 = 110.00; Line 27b additional credits 1 box(es) for 60 or over x 110.00 = 110.00; Line 32 total non-refundable credits 220.00. Line 33 balance = 962.00 - 220.00 = 742.00. Social Security is not taxable in Delaware (Line 8a). The 60-or-over exclusion takes the IRA, interest and dividends together with the pension under one 12,500 cap.
